name: singlet_statistics_pvalue_null_calibration
title: Type I error and p-value calibration under replicate-respecting nulls
description: Measures whether single-cell differential expression tests keep their nominal false-positive rate and uniform p-values when no condition effect exists, using nulls that treat donors, not cells, as replicates: donor-label permutation among control donors, technical replicates, a cell-split check, or a fitted hierarchical simulator. Needs raw counts in layers/counts, donor, condition and cell-type columns in obs, and at least 8 control donors for the permutation null; writes per-method, per-cell-type false-positive rates, p-value uniformity, complete-null call rate and a verdict to uns/null_calibration/summary. Call with dry_run true first. Do not use it to find differentially expressed genes or to test a real contrast (use the replicate-aware condition DE tool), and do not rely on cell_split_within_donor, which cannot detect donor-level inflation.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle. Needs raw counts in layers/counts.

donor_key.description: obs column identifying the donor or sample, the unit of inference. Required.

cell_type_key.description: obs column defining the per-cell-type strata for calibration.

type.description: donor_permutation relabels control donors; replicate_batch compares batches of one sample; cell_split_within_donor is a harness check; fitted_null uses a fitted generator.

condition_key.description: obs column with the condition; identifies control donors.

control_condition.description: Level of condition_key marking control donors. Required for donor_permutation and cell_split_within_donor.

batch_key.description: obs column with processing batch. Required for replicate_batch; otherwise only used to report batch balance.

n_replicates.description: Number of null replicates. For donor_permutation, distinct balanced splits are used without repetition.

methods.description: Methods to evaluate. pseudobulk_nb is the proposed default; cell_* and mast_cell are inflating baselines without a donor term.

alpha_levels.description: Nominal thresholds at which false-positive rates are reported.

fdr_q.description: Benjamini-Hochberg level for the complete-null call rate.

inflation_factor.description: Inflated when the lower 95% bound of the false-positive rate exceeds this factor times alpha. Proposed, not from the literature.

conservative_factor.description: Conservative when the upper 95% bound is below this factor times alpha. Proposed, not from the literature.

cell_types.description: Cell types to evaluate. Empty means every level of cell_type_key.

pseudobulk.description: Options for pseudobulk_* methods and dreamlet.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per donor and cell type for a pseudobulk to be kept.

outlier_nmads.description: Lower-tail library-size outlier threshold in median absolute deviations. Applies to pseudobulk_nb and pseudobulk_deseq2.

kappa.description: LN fits with estimated kappa below this value are refitted with HL. Values below 200 are refused.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for split subsets, batch sampling and generator draws; exhaustive split enumeration is deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated seconds, peak memory, device and number of distinct splits without executing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members for the requested methods instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/null_calibration/summary and varm/null_pvalues_pseudobulk_nb. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: null_type, control_donors, splits_used, replicates_run, and a calibration list with one row per method and cell type (fpr per alpha, ks_distance, lambda_gc, complete_null_call_rate, testable_genes, verdict), warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device and distinct_splits.
